"""Knowledge bundle ``knowledge-bundle/v1`` (spec C §5): models, file IO and validation.

Public API: pharma-lab builds a ``KnowledgeBundle``, calls ``write_bundle`` and then adds
each model's vectors with ``write_bundle_embeddings``; the backend import calls
``read_bundle`` and loads the vectors of its model with ``read_bundle_embeddings``. Both
sides run the same checks. Embedding files are streamed line by line, so memory holds at
most one model's vectors however many models a bundle ships.

                heading_stack.pop()
            heading_stack.append((level, title))
            headings.append((level, title))
            bodies.append([])
        else:
            bodies[-1].append(line)

    # The first body is preamble; subsequent bodies correspond to headings.
    entries: list[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], list[str]]] = []
    first_heading = next(((i, title) for i, (_, title) in enumerate(headings)), None)
    # Reparse heading paths alongside body boundaries.
    stack: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    parsed: list[tuple[int, str, tuple[str, ...]]] = []
    in_fence = None
    for line in markdown.splitlines():
        fence = re.match(r"^\s{0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})", line)
        if fence:
            marker = fence.group(1)
            if in_fence is None:
                in_fence = marker[0]
            elif marker[0] == in_fence:
                in_fence = None
        match = None if in_fence is not None else re.match(r"^ {0,3}(#{1,6})[ \t]+(.+?)\s*#*\s*$", line)
        if match:
            level, title = len(match.group(1)), match.group(2).strip()
            while stack and stack[-1][0] >= level:
                stack.pop()
            stack.append((level, title))
            parsed.append((level, title, tuple(x[1] for x in stack)))
    del headings, first_heading
    # Map the accumulated lines to their corresponding section boundaries.
    body_lines: list[list[str]] = [[]]
    in_fence = None
    parsed_index = 0
    for line in markdown.splitlines():
        fence = re.match(r"^\s{0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})", line)
        if fence:
            marker = fence.group(1)
            if in_fence is None:
                in_fence = marker[0]
            elif marker[0] == in_fence:
                in_fence = None
        match = None if in_fence is not None else re.match(r"^ {0,3}(#{1,6})[ \t]+(.+?)\s*#*\s*$", line)
        if match:
            parsed_index += 1
            body_lines.append([])
        else:
            body_lines[-1].append(line)
    if any(line.strip() for line in body_lines[0]):
        entries.append((fallback_heading, (), body_lines[0]))
    for (_, title, path), lines in zip(parsed, body_lines[1:], strict=True):
        entries.append((title, path, lines))

    result: list[MarkdownSection] = []
    table_number = 0
    for heading, path, lines in entries:
        blocks: list[BlockRecord] = []
        prose: list[str] = []

        def flush_prose() -> None:
            value = "\n".join(prose).strip()
            if value:
                blocks.append(BlockRecord(kind=BlockKind.PROSE, markdown=value))
            prose.clear()

        table: list[str] = []
        for line in lines:
            if line.startswith("|"):
                flush_prose()
                table.append(line)
            else:
                if table:
                    table_number += 1
                    blocks.append(BlockRecord(kind=BlockKind.TABLE, markdown="\n".join(table).strip(), table_key=f"t{table_number}"))
                    table.clear()
                prose.append(line)
        if table:
            table_number += 1
            blocks.append(BlockRecord(kind=BlockKind.TABLE, markdown="\n".join(table).strip(), table_key=f"t{table_number}"))
        flush_prose()
        if blocks:
            result.append(MarkdownSection(heading, path, len(result) + 1, blocks))
    return result


def slugify(text: str, *, max_length: int = 80) -> str:
    text = text.replace("Đ", "D").replace("đ", "d")
    ascii_text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii").lower()
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", ascii_text).strip("-")
    return slug[:max_length].rstrip("-")


def section_key(document_key: str, path: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    return f"{document_key}#{'/'.join(filter(None, (slugify(part) for part in path)))}" if path else f"{document_key}#body"


def _document_key(collection: object, document: object) -> str:
    return f"{collection.key}:{document.key}"


def section_choices(collection: object, documents: Iterable[object]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    choices = []
    for document in sorted(documents, key=lambda item: item.key):
        doc_key = _document_key(collection, document)
        for section in split_markdown(document.markdown, fallback_heading=document.title):
            label = " › ".join((document.title, *section.path))
            choices.append((section_key(doc_key, section.path), label))
    return choices


def build_bundle(
    collection: object,
    documents: Iterable[object],
    glossary: Sequence[GlossaryEntry],
    colloquial: Sequence[ColloquialMappingRecord],
) -> KnowledgeBundle:
    document_records: list[DocumentRecord] = []
    section_records: list[SectionRecord] = []
    for doc in sorted(documents, key=lambda item: item.key):
        key = _document_key(collection, doc)
        document_records.append(DocumentRecord(
            key=key,
            kind=doc.kind,
            title=doc.title,
            source=SourceInfo(title=doc.source_title, url=doc.source_url),
        ))
        for section in split_markdown(doc.markdown, fallback_heading=doc.title):
            section_records.append(SectionRecord(
                key=section_key(key, section.path), document_key=key,
                heading=section.heading, context_path=list(section.path), ordinal=section.ordinal,
                blocks=section.blocks,
            ))
    valid_keys = {section.key for section in section_records}
    mappings = [mapping.model_copy(update={"section_keys": [key for key in mapping.section_keys if key in valid_keys]}) for mapping in colloquial]
    identity_payload = repr((document_records, section_records, list(glossary), mappings)).encode()
    build_id = hashlib.sha256(identity_payload).hexdigest()[:16]
    return KnowledgeBundle(
        manifest={
            "schema_version": BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "collection": BundleCollection(key=collection.key, title=collection.title),
            "generator": BundleGenerator(name="pharma-agent-authoring", version="1", build_id=build_id),
            "source_digests": {}, "document_count": len(document_records), "section_count": len(section_records),
            "files": {},
        },
        documents=document_records, sections=section_records, glossary=list(glossary), colloquial_mappings=mappings,
    )
